title: 桃太郎伝説II
sources: The harness alone, from the game's HuCard on beetle pce_fast (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The HuCard and snaps were studied outside it

The first HuCard entry: the console's RAM at 0x1F0000 is #223. Menus and names lie in the HuCard as half-width katakana codes shown as hiragana; the talk's text wasn't found there and isn't read from memory

The script reads the background's tile map: each character a top and a bottom tile, from pages laid out in the half-width katakana order (hiragana, katakana) and ASCII; voiced kana by a top tile of their own; 王, 両 and … read in play. All found in snaps of the opening's pages
Played from the title through the opening's narration, the king of hell's speech and the grandfather's talk, and the grandmother in the field: two stretches from states with the script loaded

What the script said agreed with the rows read off 35 of 35 pictures, over 4 scenes (3, 14, 12 and 6); no page was said inside a press, and no screen without text was among them. Three of the grandfather's pages were held against their snaps' rows only, not seen in a picture
54 harness calls in all (by the record), none failed
notes: Read by the script games/pce/PCE-D9E1549A.lua off the tile map in video memory (it needs the host to give vram): of the framed windows, the message window, its rows once they stand. Not read: menus, the party's status, fights' numbers; who speaks only where the text says it. Kanji the rules don't give come out as U+FFFD and are logged by their tiles.
